'''Veer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]], who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Veer owned and [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a cruise [[Starship/Legends|ship]] named the ''[[Luxury]]'', which he would hire out. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was hired by the [[Sentient Beings Opposing Violence]] and Veer flew the ship to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], where the SBOV was holding a peace conference with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. However, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] attacked the ship during the conference. She tied Veer to his chair with [[Spacer's tape/Legends|spacer's tape]].
